title: workspace-mcp configuration file
description: Optional JSON configuration for the workspace-mcp server. The file is a defaults layer, never a replacement: CLI flags > environment variables > this file > built-in defaults. Secrets are not allowed here; pass the HTTP bearer token with --token or MCP_TOKEN.

$schema.description: JSON Schema reference for editor autocomplete; accepted and ignored by the server.

workspaces.description: Named workspace roots. The workspace named "default" is primary when present, otherwise the first key. Relative paths resolve against the directory containing this file and every path must exist.

additionalProperties.description: Absolute path to an existing directory (relative paths resolve against the config file directory).

shell.description: Defaults for the opt-in run_command / start_job tools. Setting shell.mode enables the tools, as if --shell was passed.

mode.description: allowlist restricts executables to shell.allow plus the built-in defaults; any skips the allowlist check.

allow.description: Extra executable names allowed in allowlist mode. Unioned with the built-in defaults, WORKSPACE_MCP_SHELL_ALLOW and --shell-allow.

deny.description: Executable names rejected in every mode, before the allowlist. A restriction: no CLI flag can remove it.

timeoutMs.description: Default run_command timeout when the caller omits timeoutMs (built-in default 120000).

maxRuntimeMs.description: Default start_job max runtime when the caller omits maxRuntimeMs (built-in default 1800000).

type.description: http behaves like --http; stdio is the default.

journalMaxBytes.description: Default rotation threshold for journal.jsonl and notes.jsonl. The WORKSPACE_MCP_JOURNAL_MAX_BYTES environment variable wins when set.

chatgpt.description: ChatGPT guided-entry preset. Declarative first-run binding to one primary workspace; disabling it restores explicit-selection-only behavior.

preset.description: False disables the guided first-run preset. Explicit workspace selection keeps working.

primary.description: Workspace name the guided entry binds to. Must name a configured workspace; anything else aborts startup. Defaults to the default workspace.

harness.description: Stateful harness session store (Slice 2). Both flags default off; enabling session registers the session/work/stage tools backed by the outside-repo store. The store path is validated outside all Git repositories at open; a violation aborts startup.

session.description: True registers the session/work/stage/checkpoint tools. False restores the pre-harness tool surface.

recall.description: True enables the scoped recall extension (Slice 3). Inert until recall ships.

dbPath.description: Explicit harness database file path. WORKSPACE_MCP_HARNESS_DB wins when set. Defaults to $XDG_CONFIG_HOME/workspace-mcp/harness.db (or ~/.config/workspace-mcp/harness.db).

skillsDir.description: Explicit MCP-local chat skills directory (<name>/SKILL.md files, read-only for the chat). Defaults to $XDG_CONFIG_HOME/workspace-mcp/skills (or ~/.config/workspace-mcp/skills).
